Rerun 

 
 Hire AI coworkers for your team. 
 They use your tools, work on a schedule, and check with you before anything that matters.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Host it yourself »

 and 200+ more in the catalog, any MCP server, 2,000+ apps through Composio 

 On the models you pick: 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 an API key, the Claude or ChatGPT subscription you already pay for, or your own model through Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or any OpenAI-compatible server 

 

 👋 Meet your new team

You tell Rerun what you need done, in plain words. The Chief of Staff interviews you, plans a team and
builds it. Each coworker gets a job, its own memory, its own skills and its own computer. You see
them all on one board, you talk to any of them like to a colleague, and they ask before they send,
pay or delete anything.

 
 
 

A few coworkers people hire on day one, each a ready-made template:

 
 
 
 
 Executive Assistant 
 Sorts your inbox, clears your calendar, briefs you every morning 
 
 
 
 Data Analyst 
 Answers your questions from your data, with charts and a weekly KPI report 
 
 
 
 Reputation Manager 
 Watches your reviews and your competitors, drafts every reply 
 
 
 
 
 
 Sales Development Rep 
 Finds prospects who fit and writes each one a first email 
 
 
 
 Social Media Manager 
 Writes a week of posts for each network, publishes when you say go 
 
 
 
 Collections Specialist 
 Chases every late invoice, without the awkward emails 
 
 
 

 ✨ Features

 
 
 

 🧑‍✈️ The Chief of Staff runs your team. Say what you need, out loud if you like. It spots what needs doing,
hires the coworker for it, and answers your coworkers by your rules while you are away.

 
 
 
 
 🖥️ Their own computer 
 A browser and a screen you can watch, and take over at any time 
 
 
 
 ✋ You stay in charge 
 They stop and ask before they send, pay or delete anything 
 
 
 
 
 
 ⏰ Work while you sleep 
 Schedules and webhook triggers: the 7am run happens without you 
 
 
 
 🤝 They work together 
 One finds the leads, the next writes to them, a third files the result 
 
 
 

And everything else a colleague needs:

- 🧠 Coworkers that remember : a soul, skills, a memory that grows with every task
- 🗺️ One board : every coworker, every Box and every running task in sight
- 💬 Chat like with a colleague : files, voice notes, tables and approvals inline
- 🔌 Plugs into everything : 200+ ready integrations, any MCP server, Composio
- 🏠 Your own servers : attach the machine your coworkers run on in one command
- ♾️ No limits : as many coworkers and seats as you want, nothing to pay

Supabase on your own machine, adding servers, HTTPS and updates.

 ☁️ Open source or Rerun Cloud?

Same product, same code. Rerun Cloud is this Rerun, hosted, plus what only a hosted service can offer.

 🛠️ Open source ☁️ Rerun Cloud 
 --- --- --- 
 Coworkers, chat, memory, skills, schedules ✅ ✅ 
 Services catalog, MCP, Composio ✅ ✅ 
 Template library Your own templates ✅ 
 A computer for each workspace You host it, one command attaches it Ready in 30 seconds 
 AI models Your keys or subscriptions Included credit, or your keys 
 Email invitations With your own Resend key ✅ 
 Premium features (LinkedIn, WhatsApp, paid data) ✅ 
 Updates Each release Continuous 
 Support Community ✅ 
 Price Free forever See plans 

 💜 Our partners

Part of Rerun Cloud runs on two partners: LinkedIn, WhatsApp and paid data. Their integrations
live in this repository, in the open.

 
 
 
 
 Treg 
 One key for 4,100+ data tools across 126 providers, paid per call 
 
 Powers paid data . A coworker finds people and leads, companies, search results, SEO
 figures and public profiles on LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Facebook and Reddit,
 all through one paid data tool. Treg picks the provider and tries the next one on a miss.
 
 apps/ui/lib/paid-data · packages/contracts/src/paid-data.ts 
 
 
 
 Linkup 
 The outreach API for AI agents: LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, iMessage 
 
 Powers the LinkedIn and WhatsApp apps . A coworker gets a real account: it searches
 people, sends invitations and messages, posts and comments, and wakes up the moment someone
 replies or accepts.
 
 apps/ui/lib/apps/linkup · apps/ui/lib/apps/linkedin · apps/ui/lib/apps/whatsapp 
 
 
 

 🎓 Rerun Experts

Need a coworker built around your business, or a hand to set Rerun up? Rerun Experts are vetted
builders, freelancers and studios who design, ship and run AI coworkers on Rerun.

 
 
 
 🔎 Hire an expert 
 Browse the directory by skill and location, and send your request from the site 
 
 
 🛠️ Become an expert 
 Get listed, build for your clients in a free sandbox, keep 95% of your template sales and earn 20% on every client you bring 
 
 
 

 🧩 How it fits together

 

 Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind, Supabase, the Vercel AI SDK, Hono, libSQL, Patchright and Docker,
in a pnpm monorepo.

 🤝 Contributing

Bug reports, fixes and docs are welcome. Read CONTRIBUTING.md first: it explains
how to run Rerun from source and how a pull request gets in.

Self-hosted installs get community support on GitHub: an issue without logs or steps to reproduce
is closed with a link to the guide. Questions and show-and-tell go to Discord.

If Rerun saves you a few hours, a ⭐ helps a lot.

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
Let an AI install it for you:

Or paste this into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, which run the commands for you:

Install Rerun, the open source AI coworkers app, for me. Follow the guide written for AI assistants: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rerun-build/rerun/master/INSTALL.md

By hand, you need Docker, Node.js 22, and a Supabase project (a free one on supabase.com works).

git clone --branch master https://github.com/rerun-build/rerun.git && cd rerun
cp .env.example .env          # fill the Supabase URL and keys, and an OpenRouter key
npx supabase link --project-ref <your-project-ref> && npx supabase db push --include-seed
node scripts/self-host-check.mjs   # generates the engine key and the secrets
docker compose up -d --build  # then open http://localhost:3000

master is the released code; a plain git clone lands on dev, where the work happens.

That's it, say hi to the Chief of Staff. 🎉

The self-hosting guide walks through every step, including Supabase on your own machine, adding servers, HTTPS and updates.
